We need to compute the orthogonal projection of b onto the subspace W spanned by w1,...,w6. The vectors are in R^8. Since they are linearly independent, we can compute the projection using the normal equations: Let W be the 8x6 matrix whose columns are w1,...,w6. The projection of b onto col(W) is W * (W^T W)^{-1} W^T b. Alternatively, solve W^T W x = W^T b for x, then projection = W x.

We'll do that. Compute W^T W (6x6) and W^T b (6x1). Then solve the linear system. The result will be rational numbers. We'll do exact arithmetic.
